# Aidevix

> Aidevix (aidevix.uz) — o'zbek tilidagi onlayn dasturlash va AI ta'lim platformasi. Frontend, Backend, AI vositalari (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT), Telegram botlar, kiberxavfsizlik va IT karyera bo'yicha video kurslar, amaliy topshiriqlar, promptlar kutubxonasi va reyting tizimi.

- Til: o'zbek (asosiy), rus, ingliz interfeysi
- Joylashuv: Toshkent, O'zbekiston
- Asoschi: Sunnatbek Yusupov (https://aidevix.uz/team)
- Aloqa: https://t.me/aidevix, support@aidevix.uz

## Asosiy sahifalar

- [Barcha kurslar](https://aidevix.uz/courses): dasturlash kurslari katalogi
- [Blog](https://aidevix.uz/blog): dasturlash va AI bo'yicha qo'llanmalar
- [Challenges](https://aidevix.uz/challenges): amaliy kod topshiriqlari
- [Prompts](https://aidevix.uz/prompts): AI promptlar kutubxonasi
- [Playground](https://aidevix.uz/playground): brauzerda kod yozish muhiti
- [Loyihalar](https://aidevix.uz/projects): Aidevix jamoasi loyihalari
- [Reyting](https://aidevix.uz/leaderboard): o'quvchilar XP reytingi
- [Jamoa](https://aidevix.uz/team): Aidevix jamoasi
